EN: Cities belonging to players of the Feudal Aristocracy subculture gain an associated House.[br/][bulletlist][bullet/]The Governor becomes the {GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.Hyperlink} of that city's House.[bullet/]Units produced in that City gain that City's House, gaining reduced upkeep and increased health regeneration while in their {GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.Hyperlink}'s army.[bullet/]Units belonging to the house additionally gain a powerful boost in combat while in the army of their {GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.Hyperlink}.[bullet/]These benefits increase based on the {GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.Hyperlink}'s {GLOBAL.RenownConcept.Hyperlink} Level.[bullet/]In addition, when the {GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.Hyperlink} gains {GLOBAL.RenownConcept.Hyperlink}, the units belonging to their house gain a small amount of {GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.Hyperlink}.[/bulletlist][br/][br/]Units summoned on the Strategic Map or gained through events join the house of the most powerful nearby friendly army.[br/]Units recruited through Rally of the Lieges gain the House of the City they're recruited to.[br/][br/]When a Governor is first assigned to a City, you may choose the House's name and banner.
